title: Australian Couscous Wrap
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make wrap filled with couscous, chicken, and vegetables, inspired by Australian cuisine.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
Grill or bake the chicken for 15-20 minutes or until cooked through.
Cook the couscous according to package instructions.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and bell pepper, cook until softened.
Add the cooked chicken to the pan and stir to combine.
Fluff the cooked couscous with a fork.
Assemble the wrap by placing a portion of couscous on the wrap, followed by the chicken and vegetable mixture.
